page.title: Presets
page.purpose: Review, edit, save, and select the durable lighting policy without confusing a draft with applied output.

states.description: Five policy presets are available with clear active and preview state.
Missing policy definitions are reported without fabricating defaults.
Unavailable metrics and effect limitations explain static fallback.
Policy save or select errors are visible and preserve the draft.
Source evidence age and stale fallback remain visible.
